title: Convolutional Neural Networks
one_sentence_summary: CNNs learn spatial filters that detect increasingly abstract visual patterns.
quick_recall: A CNN applies shared filters across an image, preserving spatial structure while learning local-to-global visual features.
core_explanation: Convolutional layers reuse a small kernel at every spatial location. Early layers tend to detect edges and textures; deeper layers combine them into shapes and semantic parts. Weight sharing makes CNNs more parameter-efficient than fully connected networks on images.
why_it_matters: CNNs established the modern visual representation learning toolkit and remain the foundation of ResNet.
